scenes.speaker: Hostel Wing
lines: It's 1:30 AM in the hostel common corridor. Room 204 has locked their door.
Your roommate Vikrant pulls out unlabelled pills: "Bro, seniors say this helps you pull an all-nighter with zero sleep."

choices.text: "Unregulated stimulants wreck your heart rate and cause severe crashes. I'll stick to black coffee and a power nap."
choices.feedback: Factual and grounded. Relying on healthy routines builds true academic endurance.

choices.text: "I'm heading to the study hall on ground floor, need proper silence."
choices.feedback: Physically changing environments removes you from high-pressure temptations.

choices.text: "Maybe just half a tablet to test?"
choices.feedback: Never consume unverified pills. Real energy comes from timed rest and balanced nutrition.

scenes.speaker: Exam Morning
lines: Next morning in the exam hall, your mind is alert and calm.
Those who took stimulants suffered severe nausea and brain fog.
